result.title: Found by Search, Broken by a Shortcut: Transfer and Tampering of Searched Intrinsic Rewards
result.comment: 22 pages, 7 figures, 11 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/chasemetoyer/found-by-search
result.summary: Can a search over innate drives find intrinsic rewards that help a reinforcement-learning agent learn, transfer to a task it never saw, and resist an exploit that was absent during the search? Each candidate reward combines four generic events (a new view, a pickup, a drop and a toggle), each with a weight, a relief and a refill rate. We ran three pre-registered stages; the search protocol was locked in a public, timestamped commit before any search result existed. CMA-ES and an equal-budget random search used 1,560 PPO training runs, and the final evaluation and tamper test used 340. On the held-out task, KeyCorridorS3R2, the CMA-ES-selected reward (E) beat task-only PPO, episodic novelty and the random-search-selected reward (R) in all 3 registered comparisons, all of them meaningful by the registered size rule. Among these generic rewards E transferred best; the earlier paper's satiation reward, which on this task is given hand-wired key and locked-door events, did better (20 of 20 seeds solved against 4 of 20; descriptive). On UnlockPickup, where that reward uses generic events, E's mean area exceeded it by 0.276 (descriptive). On the training tasks there was no registered difference between E and R: both E-over-R tests missed. A free reset action, absent during the search, collapsed E's learning on DoorKey-8x8 (mean area 0.829 without it, 0.136 with it; registered) to below task-only PPO (descriptive). The searched drives helped on every task tested, but a reward given task-specific events did better on the held-out task, and selection gave E no protection against an exploit absent from the search.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在预注册流程下用 CMA-ES 与等预算随机搜索，在由「新视野、拾取、丢弃、切换」四类通用事件加权构成的内在奖励空间中搜索（共 1560 次 PPO 训练），并在留出任务上检验所选奖励的可迁移性以及它对搜索时未曾出现的免费 reset 动作的鲁棒性。
AI.relevance_reason: 其中「新视野」驱动的搜索与探索/视觉证据获取的激励设计、以及搜索选出的目标被未见捷径（免费 reset）击穿的现象，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据获取激励与 latent 推理策略的奖励劫持、评测鲁棒性提供类比线索；但该工作属网格世界 RL，与多模态推理距离较远，需核查可迁移程度。
